oewn-02475618-n.learner: all of the people who are living on the earth.
examples: The disease was a danger to man in every country on earth.

connotation.why: a male word standing for all living people

oewn-02474924-n.learner: any member, living or extinct, of the human family of animals, marked by great intelligence, clear speech and walking upright.
examples: Early man made simple tools from stone.

connotation.why: a male word standing for the whole human kind

oewn-01167359-v.learner: to take or consume something regularly or out of habit.
examples: She does not use drugs of any kind.

connotation.why: suggests a drug habit rather than plain taking

oewn-14549784-n.learner: the general feeling of a place or situation and the effect it has on people.
examples: The whole meeting had a gloomy look about it that made everyone uneasy.

oewn-06208877-n.learner: a willingness to support someone, to stay loyal to them, or to agree with an opinion.
examples: I knew I could count on her understanding when I told her what I had done.

oewn-02406665-v.learner: to put someone forward, or to name them as a choice for an office, an honour or a position.
examples: She proposed her friend for the post of club secretary.
